# Clearing the Wreck

*Kenwyn pays for every creature cleared out of the Saltgrace, so the salvage can go on.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Bain Harbour](../towns/bain_harbour_quests.md) |
| Category | Repeatable |
| Given by | [Kenwyn](../npcs/kenwyn.md) |
| Level | 20 |

## Objectives

- Defeat 60 creature of the Saltgraces ([Cave Bat](../monsters/cave_bat.md), [Hull Louse](../monsters/hull_louse.md), [Barnacle Crab](../monsters/barnacle_crab.md), [Bilge Eel](../monsters/bilge_eel.md), [Wreck Mimic](../monsters/wreck_mimic.md))

## Rewards

- 1,041 EXP
- 280 mesos
- +20 standing with Bain Harbour

The first time you complete it instead: 1,561 EXP, 440 mesos, +30 standing with [Kenwyn](../npcs/kenwyn.md), +30 standing with Bain Harbour
